text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin your final rehearsal of
the Heartfire Ceremony. I
presume you are
all prepared?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Mukai, before we begin, I'd like to
suggest something.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We decided to divvy up the roles like it's
the real thing. So can we go
through the
whole ceremony with those roles today?

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Show me the ceremony that you
have chosen for
yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much! All right. Team, let's do
this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the final rehearsal over,
it's time for
the girls to return to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Once again, congratulations on a
successful training camp. It was a delight
to see you all prove yourselves worthy of
taking on the mantle
of Heartfire Bearer.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
I admit to taking a stern attitude during
camp in order to test you...
but you
responded with astounding dedication.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering why you were so eager to
lend us those documents...
Were you
expecting us to want to learn more on our
own?

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
It would be simple for me to teach you
everything from the start. But that
approach would not test whether or not
you were truly fit to be
Heartfire Bearers.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
A true Bearer must of her own volition
discover a role for herself in
the ceremony, just as you have done.
It is that sincerity which is most
important.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I understand now. The reason we needed
to practice all the different
rites was so
that we could find which prayer we wanted
to carry on.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
...I had an old friend who wished for a
bright future for the Umamusume of this
country—that was the prayer she offered
at the
Heartfire Ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
I would ask that you take her prayer with
you too... as you each run
toward your
futures.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You have our word—we will carry your
friend's prayer with us.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll ask for you to watch us—we'll
take everything you taught us
to heart and
fulfill our duty as Bearers!

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I await your performance on the
day of the ceremony with
great
anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Mukai, thank you for everything
you've done for us during our
stay here!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A festive melody echoes in the late
autumn air as night falls. It seems
as if the
Fleetfoot Festival has suddenly become
enveloped in an otherworldly atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
In just a few moments, the first rite, the
Entwinement, will begin. A Heartfire
Bearer now makes her appearance before
the sole slate
bonfire.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(All eyes are on me. I must perform the
opening rites with my head
held high, and
stay true to myself.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Coming together as a team and relearning
everything I thought I knew about the
ceremony, I found a dream, a prayer I want
to help come
true.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There's a prayer that only I can offer,
and
now I know what it is!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In the Entwinement, we light a fire to
symbolize the dreams of our
forerunners,
and make them blaze bright once more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With fierce yells as we dance around the
Ring with flame in hand, we
chase away all
calamity that may befall us.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
By dispelling evil,
we protect those dreams
as they pass from past to future. And the
spark, the ignition, must come from the
strength of our prayers!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now is my time! Through me their dreams
shall burn bright, safe from
misfortune—I
am the Bearer of flame!

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Concluding her ceremonious dance, the
Bearer transfers the flame to
a torch. Next
she must ascend to the Ring at the top of
the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: UOOOOOGH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Here I stand! Here we shine! Dreams
entwined, I their conduit—to the
Ring I
now go!

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Bearer's powerful voice seems to
shake the very trees! And now,
with torch
in hand,
she begins her run up to the Ring.

text_block_list.name: Male Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Here at the Ring, the crowd eagerly awaits
the arrival of the Heartfire
Bearer from the
foot of the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Male Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And here she is! With torch in hand, the
Bearer has come running up
the mountain!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Heartfire! Dreams of my forerunners!
Tempest swirling within me! Burn bright!
Scorch the heavens, and shine a guiding
light for all to
see!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Protect the runners of today, and the
runners of tomorrow! Dispel the
dark
clouds that would bring calamity upon
them!)

text_block_list.name: Male Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What a sight to behold! As the Bearer
dances around the Ring, the entire
mountaintop roars to life as if swept
up in
a great blaze!

text_block_list.name: Male Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The flame carried up from the bottom has
been transferred to the brazier. A new
Bearer will now read the Dedication and
scatter the
flowers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...It is time.
This is for those noble souls
who came before.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Here I stand. Here we shine. Dreams
entwined, I their conduit—words
I now
offer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To all Umamusume in days past who
stepped off the track with regrets, held
back by the shackles of your
circumstances, bodies, or
both...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have heard your prayers for none to
suffer the same fate, and felt
their warmth.
As one bound by the same shackles, I wish
to join you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But also... know that your prayers have
blessed those running today
with a
future—and one day I shall prove it with
my own two legs!

text_block_list.name: Male Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Having recited the Dedication, the Bearer
will now take the beautiful
bouquet and
toss its flowers toward the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Prayers and wishes—receive warmth from
the flame and bloom proud!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(We will bloom proud like these flowers in
our time. No matter what hardships await,
we will press on, with your prayers as the
fire at our
heels.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Flowers bloom, dreams to follow. Now and
forevermore, may all paths
yet unknown
be lined with peace and glory.
